name: Anna McKie
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I provide a safe and confidential environment allowing the client to develop a therapeutic relationship for exploring problems and difficulties in life. These can include issues with relationships, conflicts at work, parenting challenges, life choices, achieving goals, depression, anxiety, self esteem, negative feelings, destructive patterns of behaviour, stress, trauma, grief, anger, shame and despair. This therapeutic relationship offers the client new experiences that facilitate transformational change and personal growth.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Hilina Hagos
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Hi, I’m Hilina—a registered psychotherapist and counsellor committed to providing a safe, supportive, and non-judgmental space where you can explore your thoughts, emotions, and life experiences. Whether you're facing anxiety, depression, trauma, identity shifts, or relationship challenges, I offer a compassionate and culturally responsive approach tailored to your unique story. If you're dealing with unresolved trauma, grief, or identity shifts, I offer a calm, grounding presence and tools to move forward. As someone who values diversity, I honour the intersection of mental health with race, ethnicity, culture, gender, and faith.

name: Tess Tokatlidis
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a trauma informed counsellor and qualified Clinical Somatic Psychotherapist. I work within a client centred approach and am informed by attachment, self psychological, inter-subjective, somatic and trauma theories. PTSD and complex PTSD, depression, anxiety, confusion, self-image, relationship issues, life transitions, grief and loss, stress, relationship issues, phobias, communication challenges and anger are some areas of my expertise.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Lukas Wooller
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Do you feel stuck, overwhelmed, or at the mercy of your emotions? Perhaps anxiety is making life feel unmanageable, or depression has left you feeling empty and disconnected. I work with adults experiencing anxiety, depression, trauma, stress, anger, low self-esteem, relationship difficulties, life transitions, childhood trauma, addiction and existential concerns.

name: Andrew Green
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Hi there, I am a PACFA-registered psychotherapist working in private practice. My therapeutic approach is grounded in an integrative and non-pathologising view that draws upon the latest research while always honouring the primacy of your lived experience. I believe that therapy is a natural collaborative process of co-regulation and inner enquiry that simply creates the ideal conditions for healing to occur.
